rationale: Single event listing on a redundant aggregator; mine once for partner names, weak standalone signal for Kosovo.
Recurring WB6 intergovernmental digital summit page; programmes name Kosovo ministries, BQK and payment vendors each edition.
One-off archived session record with speaker affiliations; useful evidence for historic Kosovo payments panels, not a producing feed.
Recurring country-level award announcements citing Kosovo banks and their digital platforms; check reuse terms but public and in-scope.
Single award release on bkt-ks.com with 5 siblings; monitor the bank newsroom parent instead, liveness unverified.
One event post on Banka Ekonomike's site; value is the newsroom parent as an index of forum participation.
Regional fintech association homepage; member/partner roster worth one mining pass, credibility and Kosovo depth unproven.
Consultancy blog post on a Kosovo bank-fintech synergy event; keep the blog parent as a low-noise partnership trace.
AmCham Kosovo runs recurring sponsored conferences and recognitions; sponsor and awardee lists map vendor-bank relationships.
Central-bank fintech hackathon sponsor/challenge roster; regional analogue for BQK, mine for vendors courting WB central banks.
Serbian banking association events page with a digital banking committee; recurring regional vendor-exhibitor signal, sr-language coverage.
Structured virtual expo exhibitor directory — densest sr-language vendor list in this cell; mine once for leads.
Editorial pan-European event calendar; cheap discovery only, low Kosovo specificity and unclear reuse terms.
Low-credibility third-party event listing, unverified URL; only marginal value for reconstructing event dates.
BQK-licensed NBFI running Kosovo's largest non-bank bill-payment counter network; biller catalogue is the best public non-bank acceptance map.
Recurring procurement notices naming the post office's IT, terminal and payment suppliers — direct vendor attribution.
Single dated regulator PDF on card/POS usage; authoritative denominator evidence, the BQK parent supplies the recurring series.
Authoritative BQK register of licensed MFIs, PSPs and e-money institutions — the core actor and buyer list for this cell.
One regulation PDF opening payment-system access to non-bank PSPs; key legal trigger evidence, track via BQK regulations parent.
Licensed non-bank payment institution with agent network; biller list and own tech buying are directly in scope.
Second Kosovo non-bank bill-payment operator; peer/competitor and buyer of agent-terminal technology.
LinkedIn company page is auth-walled and ToS-restricted; valuable signals but a human must clear access.
Largest Kosovo biller's payment-channel pages enumerate acceptance partners, wallets and acquirers as they change.
Largest water utility's new online billing/payment channel; repeatable cluster of billing and acceptance buyers.
Incumbent state telco announcements page carrying service launches, partnerships and procurement notices.
Second mobile operator's site; buyer of billing/top-up/acceptance tech and likely carrier-billing partner, but news is diffuse.
Regulator for electronic communications and postal services publishing market reports and the licensed-operator register.
MFI association member list is a ready-made buyer roster for core, lending and agent technology; mine once, refresh periodically.
